(2) 'Bathroom Accessories' (2 products: HAY Colour Crate, Shopper Bag) are storage items, zero genuinely decorative products -- category excluded, no row emitted. (3) 'Candles': 17 total, 1 excluded (Ura Scented Candle -- product page explicitly says 'scented wax'/'Lemongrass scent'), remaining 16 (Dryp/Column/Hexagon/Pure Candles lines) confirmed unscented via descriptions ('pure stearin', 'solid dyed colours') -- Home Fragrance exclusion applied at product level, not category level. 'Wall Sculptures' similarly renders 0 products currently -- row emitted with qty 0 (in-scope type, genuinely empty right now). (7) 'Decorative Items' is a mixed roll-up: 111 total, but 71 are exact cross-listed duplicates (same product URL) of items already counted under Vases/Bowls/Candle Holders/Mirrors/Lanterns/Flower Pots & Planters/Hooks & Knobs/Clocks/Candles -- dropped per Rule 0.6 (pure facet re-cut). Of the 40 titles unique to this node, 9 are out of category scope (4x HAY Tote Bag, 2x Shopper/storage bag, 3x HAY Colour Crate storage box, 1x Care Kit) -- excluded. The remaining 31 (trays, centerpieces, sculptures, ceramic baskets, jars, boxes, a couple of vase variants not listed elsewhere) are genuine unique in-scope decorative objects -- qty 31 reported, evidence documents the curation math. (8) Outdoors > 'Accessories' (5 ceramic baskets) is a 100% exact-URL subset of Kitchen & Dining > Tableware -- dropped per Rule 0.6, not a separate row. (9) Outdoors > 'Flower Pots & Planters' (19) and Decoration & Accessories > 'Flower Pots & Planters' (23) overlap on 18 of 19 outdoor items (same product URLs, dual-categorised indoor/outdoor) -- Rule 0.6 room-tree vs type-tree case, both emitted per the rule with overlap documented here rather than dropped. (10) Lighting > 'Portable Lamps' (107) and 'Table Lamps' (190) overlap on 78 shared product URLs (many portable lamps are also tagged as table lamps) -- both are genuine distinct nav leaves with unique content beyond the overlap (29 portable-only, 112 table-only), so both emitted per Rule 0.6, overlap documented rather than summed. (11) Lighting > 'Lighting Accessories' (3 items: 'Opal LED 25-4W' bulb, 2x fabric/cord sets) excluded entirely -- bulbs and wiring/cord hardware are explicitly excluded. (12) Books & Magazines: only 'Book Ends' (1, 'Converge Book Ends - Lava Stone') is genuinely decorative (a stone sculptural object); Books (22, literal coffee-table books), Bookstands (3, functional), Bookweights (0) excluded as non-decor/functional. (13) Kitchen & Dining Drinkware/Jugs & Carafes/Serve Ware/Tableware (glassware and tableware, no overlap with each other) included per brief; Cleaning Accessories/Cutlery/Kitchenware excluded (cookware/cutlery/cleaning). (14) All Furniture and all Textiles subtrees excluded wholesale per brief; Storage Furniture, Bins, Care Kits, Organizers, storage-systems all excluded as storage/cleaning; Wall Papers excluded (explicit); Outdoor Umbrellas excluded (functional/furniture-adjacent); B2B and Brands (designer listing pages) never extracted.
